content: These references include randomized controlled trials, comparative studies, and long-term analyses of various antiretroviral therapies. The studies evaluate different drug combinations, such as tenofovir, emtricitabine, efavirenz, dolutegravir, and others, in treatment-naïve HIV-1-infected patients. They also explore outcomes like virologic suppression, immunologic response, lipid profiles, renal safety, and body composition changes. Many of these studies are published in reputable journals and presented at international conferences, reflecting advancements in HIV treatment strategies over the years.
